elements.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
elements.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, etc.)
sub_elements.quality_note: Properly formatted PhysioNet DOI present as both id and doi fields

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: Bridge2AI-Voice - An ethically-sourced, diverse voice dataset linked to health information; description spans ~1500 chars covering purpose, modalities, cohorts, and version counts
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear title plus comprehensive multi-sentence description well beyond 200 chars

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: [voice biomarker, acoustic biomarker, Bridge2AI, voice disorders, Parkinson's disease, MFCC, OpenSMILE, BIDS, ...] (50+ terms)
sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive keyword list covering domain, conditions, methods, tools, and standards

sub_elements.name: Dataset Landing Page or Platform URL
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://docs.b2ai-voice.org; download_url: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/; external_resources with PhysioNet landing page
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple accessible landing/documentation pages provided

sub_elements.name: Associated Project or Program
sub_elements.evidence: publisher: Bridge2AI-Voice Consortium, University of South Florida; external_resources: Bridge2AI Program https://bridge2ai.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear association with the NIH Bridge2AI Common Fund program

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Mechanism Defined
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms: distributed under Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License; raw audio via controlled access (DACO)
sub_elements.quality_note: Clearly distinguishes registered access (features) vs controlled access (raw audio)

sub_elements.name: Data Use Agreement Required?
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'Only registered users who sign the specified Data Use Agreement (Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access Agreement) can access files'; DTUA for raw audio
sub_elements.quality_note: DUA requirement and signing process explicitly described, including DTUA for controlled access

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: download_url: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/; distributions[].path point to PhysioNet and mailto:DACO@b2ai-voice.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Direct platform download links plus access-request contact provided

sub_elements.name: File Formats Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: Parquet (spectrograms/features), TSV/JSON (phenotype/static features), WAV (controlled access)
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific formats named with content mapping and BIDS v1.9.0 structure

sub_elements.name: External Links to Similar or Related Datasets
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: PhysioNet, Health Data Nexus, b2aiprep, REDCap dictionary, NIH RePORTER, Zenodo, Interspeech publication (12 resources)
sub_elements.quality_note: Rich set of related repositories, platforms, and references

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'Commercial and non-commercial research use permitted for Authorized Researchers'; ip_restrictions honoring Fort Lauderdale/Open Science
sub_elements.quality_note: Reuse permissions explicit for both commercial and non-commercial research

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized
sub_elements.evidence: Parquet, TSV, JSON, WAV; BIDS v1.9.0 compliant directory structure throughout
sub_elements.quality_note: Standard, tool-friendly formats plus BIDS neuroimaging community standard

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.evidence: BIDS v1.9.0 compliance repeatedly stated; diagnostic labels 'Per Bridge2AI protocols and ICD-10 codes'; FAIR and CARE principles
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit conformance to BIDS, ICD-10 coding, and FAIR/CARE frameworks

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Defined for Linking
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: 'Each element contains participant_id, session_id, task_name'; BIDS sub-{participant_id}/ses-{session_id}/ structure
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear linking keys (participant/session/task IDs) defined across files

sub_elements.name: Documentation of Processing Tools for Reproducibility
sub_elements.evidence: software: b2aiprep (Apache-2.0, GitHub), SenseLab, OpenSMILE, Praat, Parselmouth, torchaudio, OpenAI Whisper with parameters (16 kHz, 512-point FFT)
sub_elements.quality_note: Named tools with versions/parameters and public code repositories

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review Documented
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews / human_subject_research: 'IRB review and approval obtained from University of South Florida Single IRB with subsite IRB approvals'
sub_elements.quality_note: IRB oversight documented with Single IRB model and bioethics integration

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified: 'HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification applied... Dates rebased: Yes. Geographic information removed/generalized: Yes'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific method (HIPAA Safe Harbor) with itemized de-identification actions

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Removed or Masked
sub_elements.evidence: cleaning_strategies: 'removed direct identifiers (names, civic addresses, social security numbers), indirect identifiers... sensitive information'
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit enumeration of removed direct, indirect, and sensitive identifiers

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.evidence: informed_consent: 'All participants duly informed and provided prospective informed consent... via IRB-approved consent process'
sub_elements.quality_note: Consent process, scope, and withdrawal rights detailed

sub_elements.name: Ethical Sourcing Statement Included
sub_elements.evidence: purposes: 'ethically sourced flagship dataset'; ethical_reviews: bioethics guidance integrated throughout; dedicated Ethics module developing consent guidelines
sub_elements.quality_note: Strong ethical sourcing narrative embedded in purposes and ethics review

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Population Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: instances + subpopulations: five disease cohorts plus pediatric and control groups with inclusion criteria and validation methods
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed demographic and clinical cohort descriptions with eligibility

sub_elements.name: Number of Participants or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: counts: 833; 'Version 3.0 contains approximately 833 adult participants with ~61,937 voice-derived recordings. Pediatric dataset v1.0 adds 300 participants'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific participant and recording counts across versions

sub_elements.name: Modalities or Data Types Listed
sub_elements.evidence: voice recordings, spectrograms, MFCCs, acoustic features, clinical phenotype data, EHR, imaging (laryngoscopy/MRI/CT), genomics
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple modalities clearly listed including derived acoustic features

sub_elements.name: Conditions or Phenotypes Represented
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations: Voice Disorders, Neurological/Neurodegenerative, Mood/Psychiatric, Respiratory, Pediatric cohorts with named diagnoses
sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive phenotype enumeration per cohort with validation modalities

sub_elements.name: File Dimensions or Sampling Rates Provided
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies: 'resampling to 16 kHz'; spectrograms '513xN dimensions'; MFCC 'Output dimension 60xN'; FFT '25ms window, 10ms hop, 512-point'
sub_elements.quality_note: Precise sampling rates and array dimensions documented

elements.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking

sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed scientific rationale and enumerated research gaps

sub_elements.name: Primary Research Objective or Task
sub_elements.evidence: tasks: 7 defined ML/research tasks; intended_uses: 'development and validation of AI/ML models for voice as a biomarker of health'
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific ML tasks and primary intended use clearly stated

sub_elements.name: Funding Source or Grant Agency Listed
sub_elements.evidence: funders: 'National Institutes of Health (NIH) Common Fund Bridge2AI Program'; NIBIB supporting PhysioNet

elements.description: Can data collection and processing steps be replicated or understood?

sub_elements.name: Preprocessing or Cleaning Steps Documented
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies (8 steps): monaural conversion, 16 kHz resampling, FFT spectrograms, MFCC, OpenSMILE/Praat/torchaudio features, Whisper transcription, BIDS conversion
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed, reproducible preprocessing pipeline with parameters

sub_elements.name: Open-Source Processing Code Provided
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: b2aiprep https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep (Apache-2.0); bridge2ai-docs and bridge2ai-redcap repos (MIT)

sub_elements.name: External Standards or References Cited
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Interspeech 2024 publication (DOI 10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926), Zenodo archive DOI, NIH RePORTER; BIDS v1.9.0, ICD-10, 45 CFR 46
sub_elements.quality_note: Published papers, DOIs, and regulatory/data standards cited

sub_elements.name: Known Risks or Use Constraints Listed
sub_elements.evidence: discouraged_uses (hiring, insurance, surveillance, re-identification) and prohibited_uses (unauthorized research, sale, re-identification)
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear discouraged and prohibited use constraints enumerated

sub_elements.name: Conflicts of Interest Declared
sub_elements.evidence: No conflicts_of_interest field or COI statement present in the datasheet
sub_elements.quality_note: No explicit conflict-of-interest declaration found

elements.name: Cross-Platform and Community Integration
elements.description: Does the dataset connect to wider data ecosystems, repositories, or standards?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Published on a Recognized Platform
sub_elements.evidence: distributions/maintainers: published on PhysioNet (MIT LCP) and Health Data Nexus (T-CAIREM, University of Toronto)
sub_elements.quality_note: Published on two recognized biomedical data platforms

sub_elements.name: Cross-referenced DOIs or Related Dataset Links
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13834653, Interspeech DOI 10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926, version-specific PhysioNet DOIs
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple cross-referenced DOIs to related work and archives

sub_elements.name: Community Standards or Schema Reference
sub_elements.evidence: BIDS v1.9.0 (Brain Imaging Data Structure), ICD-10, FAIR and CARE principles referenced throughout
sub_elements.quality_note: Strong adherence to community standards and schemas

sub_elements.name: Associated Outreach Materials
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Bridge2AI Voice Scholars Training (b2aivoicescholars.org), project documentation site; existing_uses: Summer School and hackathon
sub_elements.quality_note: Training programs, documentation, and educational events linked

sub_elements.name: Similar Dataset Links or Thematic Grouping
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources: Bridge2AI Program (bridge2ai.org); pediatric dataset v1.0 distributed as related separate dataset
sub_elements.quality_note: Thematic grouping under Bridge2AI program and companion pediatric dataset

strengths: Exceptional ethical and privacy documentation: IRB approval, HIPAA Safe Harbor with itemized de-identification, informed consent, Certificate of Confidentiality, and pediatric protections
Fully specified access model distinguishing registered access (features) from DACO-controlled access (raw audio), with explicit DUA/DTUA requirements

Highly reproducible technical pipeline with named tools (b2aiprep, OpenSMILE, Praat, torchaudio, Whisper), exact parameters (16 kHz, 513xN spectrograms, 512-point FFT), and public Apache-2.0/MIT code repositories
Comprehensive version provenance: five releases with dates, per-version change notes, semi-annual cadence, and version-specific DOIs
Transparent funding with named agencies (NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI, NIBIB) and specific award numbers (3OT2OD032720-01S3, R01EB030362)
Candid limitations and bias disclosure including clinic-based selection bias, English-only cohorts, and explicit is_representative: false flag
weaknesses: No conflicts-of-interest declaration is present anywhere in the datasheet
Collection sites are described by count and type ('five North American sites') but individual site names/locations are only partially specified (e.g., SickKids for pediatrics)
recommendations: Add an explicit conflicts_of_interest / ethics.conflicts_of_interest statement covering the consortium investigators and platform relationships
Enumerate the specific adult collection sites and their institutional affiliations to strengthen collection-setting transparency
Consider adding a formal re-identification risk assessment beyond HIPAA Safe Harbor, which is currently noted as not yet conducted
